title: Pair duplication run invariant
statement: For every finite bit string $x$, every natural number $j$ with $j \\le |x|$, and every such proof of the inequality, after $2j$ steps the constructed machine is in state $0$ of its five-state scanning phase, with input head at position $j+1$, no work tapes, and output equal to the first $j$ bits of $x$, each doubled in place.
